{{Top|leg}}
'''Boulder-dozers''' were a type of earth-moving machines that were equipped with [[Laser/Legends|laser-scorchers]] that could vaporize large rocks and other debris. They were manufactured by [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]].
